The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 31/12/2022 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Goharganj, Distt. Raisen (M.P.) in Special Case No.1100098/2020, whereby the appellant stands convicted and sentenced as under:-

sentences.text: When these facts are taken into consideration, then it appears to be a case of over implication so far as appellant No.2-Prabhat Patel is concerned.
There are good chances of success.
Hence, it is prayed that remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended and he be released on bail.
Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and submits that no indulgence can be shown in the matter.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant No.2-Prabhat Patel and release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing the find amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rs.Fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 24/11/2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, 3 CRA-2681-2023 execution of remaining part of jail sentence imposed upon appellant No.2- Prabhat Patel shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of the appeal.
C.C. as per rules.
